title: The Indian Independence Movement
text: The Indian independence movement was a decades-long struggle against British colonial rule, gaining significant momentum in the 20th century under leaders including Mahatma Gandhi, who advocated nonviolent civil disobedience (satyagraha). Key milestones include the Non-Cooperation Movement, the Salt March (1930), and the Quit India Movement (1942). India achieved independence on 15 August 1947, alongside the partition that created Pakistan.
